devdoc.details: This is the owner of upgradeable proxy contracts. Proxy contracts use a TransparentProxy pattern, any admin related call like upgrading a contract or changing the admin needs to be send through this contract.

params._implementation: Address of the implementation accepting the proxy.
params._proxy: Address of the proxy being accepted.

params._data: Encoded function to call on the implementation after accepting the proxy.
params._implementation: Address of the implementation accepting the proxy.
params._proxy: Address of the proxy being accepted.

params._newAdmin: Address to transfer proxy administration to.

params._proxy: Address of the proxy for which to get the admin.

returns._0: The address of the current admin of the proxy.

getProxyImplementation(address).details: This is needed because only the proxy admin can query it.

params._proxy: Address of the proxy for which to get the implementation.

returns._0: The address of the current implementation of the proxy.

getProxyPendingImplementation(address).details: This is needed because only the proxy admin can query it.

params._proxy: Address of the proxy for which to get the pending implementation.

returns._0: The address of the pending implementation of the proxy.

devdoc.title: GraphProxyAdmin

NewOwnership(address,address).notice: Emitted when a new owner/governor has accepted their role

NewPendingOwnership(address,address).notice: Emitted when a new owner/governor has been set, but is pending acceptance

acceptOwnership().notice: Admin function for pending governor to accept role and update governor. This function must called by the pending governor.

acceptProxyAndCall(address,address,bytes.notice: Accepts a proxy and call a function on the implementation.

changeProxyAdmin(address,address).notice: Changes the admin of a proxy.

getProxyAdmin(address).notice: Returns the admin of a proxy. Only the admin can query it.

getProxyImplementation(address).notice: Returns the current implementation of a proxy.

getProxyPendingImplementation(address).notice: Returns the pending implementation of a proxy.

pendingGovernor().notice: Address of the new governor that is pending acceptance

transferOwnership(address).notice: Admin function to begin change of governor. The `_newGovernor` must call `acceptOwnership` to finalize the transfer.

upgrade(address,address).notice: Upgrades a proxy to the newest implementation of a contract.
